name: hvnstd/genisys-php8
description: Genisys PHP 8.x port — ReactOS-style architectural rewrite of MCPE 0.14.x server kernel (protocol 70)

suggest.ext-pcntl: Signal handling on Linux (not available on Windows, not required)
suggest.ext-parallel: Parallel task execution (Fiber fallback used when absent)
suggest.ext-leveldb: LevelDB world format support (reeze/php-leveldb; no Windows dll, Anvil format works without it)
suggest.symfony/yaml: Full YAML support (MiniYaml fallback used when absent)

scripts.check: bash -c 'for f in modules/*.php compat/*.php index.php; do php -l "$f" > /dev/null || exit 1; done && echo lint ok'
